maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from consumers placing sports bets and playing online games (FanDuel, Sky Bet, Sisal), not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by individual consumers betting and gaming through FanDuel, Paddy Power, Sportsbet and similar brands, not by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its brands, such as FanDuel in the US, and product launches; Sisal, Snai and others were occasional large deals.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer bettors can switch easily to rival sportsbooks and casino apps; brand and promotions are the only draw.

notes: Flutter has made several large acquisitions (Sisal, Snai, NSX), but organic growth appears to be the main driver.
